name: Divinity Candy
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put sugar, corn syrup, and cold water into a saucepan and boil until it will harden in water
Have ready the beaten whites of 2 eggs
When the syrup has boiled sufficiently beat it into the whites of the eggs and add vanilla
Add nut meats just before turning out in the pan
This candy is better when a couple of days old than when first made

source.originalInstructions:
1. Put sugar, corn syrup, and cold water into a saucepan and boil until it will harden in water
2. Have ready the beaten whites of 2 eggs
3. When the syrup has boiled sufficiently beat it into the whites of the eggs and add vanilla
4. Add nut meats just before turning out in the pan
5. This candy is better when a couple of days old than when first made
